Starting prices cover the session described. Additional people, travel, studio rentals, permits, rush delivery, and special requests are quoted separately. Your total, delivery schedule, and booking terms will be confirmed before you reserve.

Review note: these are proposed packages and market-based starting prices. Session length, image counts, and booking terms need Trevor’s final approval.

The details, made simple.

What is included in a session?

The session plan above includes photography and a curated edited digital gallery. We’ll confirm the final scope, personal printing permission, and delivery date in your booking details.

How do I reserve a date?

Start with an inquiry. We’ll confirm availability, location, and your session plan, then I’ll send the booking steps. Sending an inquiry does not reserve a date or charge you.

When will my photographs be ready?

We’ll agree on the delivery timeline before you book. If you have an announcement deadline or a time-sensitive event, include that in your inquiry.

What if the weather changes?

We’ll stay in touch about the forecast and talk through a different time, location, or date if conditions don’t suit your session. Rescheduling terms will be confirmed when booking.
